newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiichi Corp falls after All Corp liquidation news.
newsitem.headline: Daiichi Corp falls after All Corp liquidation news.

text.p: Shares in Daiichi Corp, a Japanese non-bank financial firm, fell in heavy trade on the over-the-counter market on Thursday after news that another non-bank, All Corp, would seek special liquidation, brokers said.
By 0139 GMT, Daiichi shares stood at 80 yen, down three yen from the previous close.
Daiichi was the most heavily traded issue on the over-the-counter-market.
"Daiichi shares moved as investors associated the issue with a media report on All Corp's special liquidation," an official at a second-tier brokerage said.
All Corp said on Thursday it was seeking court-protected special liquidation with total debts on borrowings worth 274.5 billion yen.
The announcement was preceded by a report in the Nihon Keizai Shimbun saying the company was close to making such a filing.
The special liquidation process would start in late March, All Corp said in a statement.
